whatIs: CollectUI is an inspiration gallery of interfaces and websites with a new selection every day, curated by designers. You browse it by Designers, Categories, and Trending, and you can save favorites.
It's a good fit when you need fresh visual ideas for a screen or a portfolio and prefer to explore by category or by author.
uses: Looking for references for a specific screen, such as a dashboard or a login, before laying it out.
Following designers whose style you like and checking their recent work.
Saving favorites to build a moodboard for the project and share it with the client.
caveats: These are inspiration images, with no code or specs, so you have to rebuild each design by hand.
The homepage includes sponsor blocks and a network of related sites that distract from the gallery.
The pieces come from designers' posts on X, so many are concepts that never became a real product.
pricingNote: Free to browse; the site sells ad space to sponsors.
idealFor: Designers and developers looking for UI ideas every day.
